primitives.meaning: an authoritative record that a defined action is owed by a named person; a due date recorded against it
entryFilters: an authoritative record that a defined action is owed by a named person
a due date recorded against it
no instance of this journey is already open for the the outstanding obligation

primitives.asks: Is there a gap before the deadline worth waiting through?

branches.label: Time remains
branches.test: the due date is far enough out that the reminder point has not been reached

branches.label: Due now or already past
branches.test: the reminder point is reached or gone by the time this qualifies

cancelOn.meaning: the obligation is satisfied, cancelled or adjusted to nothing
the obligation changes but remains owed

primitives.reads: the the outstanding obligation re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

primitives.does: Re-read the obligation from authoritative current state immediately before sending - what is owed now, what has been received against it, and what the deadline is now. A message built from the state an hour ago is how somebody who has already settled is asked to settle again

primitives.asks: Is anything still owed at the moment of sending?

branches.label: Still outstanding
branches.test: the record shows the obligation unsatisfied in whole or in part

branches.label: Nothing outstanding
branches.test: it has been satisfied, cancelled or adjusted to nothing

primitives.state: no longer owed; nothing was sent
primitives.reEntry: a later obligation owed by the same person is a new instance

primitives.purpose: Name the obligation, what remains outstanding, the deadline and the single way to discharge it.
primitives.brief: Name the obligation, what remains outstanding, the deadline and the single way to discharge it. Partly met is not met, and the figure named is what is still owed rather than what it started as - the difference is what makes the message answerable

cancelOn.meaning: the obligation is satisfied in the system of record

primitives.reads: the the outstanding obligation re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

branches.test: an authoritative event discharges the obligation in full

branches.label: Cancelled or adjusted away
branches.test: the obligation no longer exists to be met

branches.label: Still owed at the deadline
branches.test: the deadline passed with something still outstanding

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Confirm it is discharged and that nothing further is expected.
primitives.brief: Confirm it is discharged and that nothing further is expected. An obligation met and never acknowledged is one the person keeps checking, and checking is what a support contact is made of
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.reEntry: a new obligation owed by the same person is a new instance

primitives.purpose: Say once that the deadline has passed, what stands now, and what consequence policy actually attaches to it.
primitives.brief: Say once that the deadline has passed, what stands now, and what consequence policy actually attaches to it. One notice - repeating it is a recovery sequence, and that belongs to whoever owns the consequence rather than to whoever owns the reminder
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.asks: Does a defined consequence own this now?

branches.label: A consequence applies
branches.test: policy defines a further step for an obligation unmet past its deadline

branches.label: Nothing further is defined
branches.test: no consequence is defined and the obligation simply stands unmet

primitives.on: an obligation still outstanding past its deadline with a defined consequence attached
carries: what remains outstanding, its due date and its history
which reminders were sent, when, and what they stated

primitives.state: lapsed unmet; no further consequence is defined
primitives.reEntry: if the obligation is later satisfied, the confirmation runs from that event
